clips.title: Why not you?
clips.why: The heart of the video and its most-marked moment (29 and 26 like comments on this exact second). Rohn turns a vague dream into a direct personal confrontation: 'you've got the brains, you can make decisions, you can change your life, you can build a financial wall around your family nothing can get through' — then lands 'why not you' twice. It removes the viewer's quiet excuse that they are somehow not the kind of person things happen to. Viewers literally wrote 'I will come back to this a lot' on this second. Note: L0049 opens mid-sentence ('do it from up here'); a cleaner edge is 'you've got the brains' at L0050, and the hook line 'my personal question to you is why not you' can be flashed from L0049.

clips.title: If the why is powerful, the how is easy
clips.why: Two separate quotable lines delivered back to back: the mechanism ('if the why is powerful the how is easy') and the warning ('without a vision we die, without a vision we perish, without a dream we're nothing'). Both lines are quoted word-for-word in the audience's comments — one at 93 likes saying they have listened to this speech over 100 times. The first line hands the viewer a way to think about their own stuckness; the second makes the absence of a dream feel existential. Under 22 seconds total, and either line can be flashed at the head of the reel.

clips.title: Why not see what kind of person you can become
clips.why: A permission roll: 'why not see how much you can earn, why not see how much you can learn, why not see what kind of person you can become.' It takes away the assumption that wanting more needs justification — the 'why not' is the whole argument. This is the second of Rohn's four questions and the audience's loudest comment theme ('why not me? why not now? the 4 most important questions I have ever been asked', 129 likes) lives here. Cutting note: L0029 opens with meta framing ('here's number two') and L0031 ends mid-phrase — the editor should trim to 'why not see how much you can earn... why not see how many people you can reach', pulling 'can reach' from the top of L0032.

video_read: This is Jim Rohn on stage at a Herbalife 'Extravaganza', delivering his famous four-questions talk: why, why not, why not you, why not now. The motivational material lives exactly in those question builds — the 'why not you' passage is the most-commented moment in the video, and the audience quotes the 'why/how' and 'without a vision' lines verbatim. Herbalife product pitches thread through and contaminate several stretches (especially the 'why not now' build), which I have worked around rather than through.
